title: Simulation reproducibility and uncertainty auditor — Capability specification
body: Public edition. Public research and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Public edition. Public research and engineering knowledge, fact-checked reference. Simulation reproducibility and uncertainty auditor is a apex creation capability. Purpose: See the capability name for the full scope.. Inputs: a defined objective with constraints and acceptance criteria. Outputs: the specified artifact — code, design, analysis, or verified result — plus its evidence package. Constraints: available compute, data, tools, and permissions. Expected behavior: the capability either produces a verified result or reports exactly what is missing. Proposed capabilities and research directions — not claims that these already exist or can all be achieved with current technology. 'Boundless' means the catalog and its combinations can keep expanding; actual execution still depends on available compute, storage, data, software, permissions, and physical resources.
